name: test_external_delivery_gate_rejects_one_unapproved_address
description:
Objective: External delivery gate rejects one unapproved address.
Preconditions: Repository dependencies are installed; execute in the deterministic lane with no deployed-service or customer-data dependency.
Steps:
1. Run the case in the repository deterministic lane with the deployed browser/service fixtures disabled.
2. Import the production-support rule or page-object contract exercised by tests/unit/notifications/test_external_delivery_guard.py.
3. Create only the isolated fixture/state encoded in the authoritative test definition; do not substitute customer data.
4. Invoke `monkeypatch.setenv` with the recorded partition and capture its return value or raised error.
5. Invoke `monkeypatch.setattr` with the recorded partition and capture its return value or raised error.
6. Evaluate the encoded observable UI/service checks: `assert_external_delivery_ready`.
7. Evaluate the deterministic assertion(s): `pytest.raises(AssertionError, match='third-party@example.test')`.
8. Record any mismatch as a normal failure; do not skip, xfail, silently retry, or weaken the assertion.
Expected: 1. Observable scenario outcome: External delivery gate rejects one unapproved address.
2. The encoded UI/service checks pass: External delivery ready.
3. The authoritative deterministic expression(s) evaluate as encoded: `pytest.raises(AssertionError, match='third-party@example.test')`.
4. No unintended record, state transition, notification, or cross-test data residue is produced.
